name: skill-ds-docs
description: Updates all living documentation after a feature is implemented. Reads analysis.md and design.md to determine what changed, then updates FEATURES.md, SPEC.md, and conditionally ARCHITECTURE.md, DOMAIN.md, BACKEND.md, and FRONTEND.md. Use when a feature has passed review (UPDATE_DOCS) or when the orchestrator exhausts all implementation retries (DOCUMENT_FAILURE).
